open flame or other ignition source. Keep container tightly closed. Avoid breathing vapours and dust. IF IN EYES: rinse cautiously with water for several minutes. If eye irritation
persists: get medical advice. If skin irritation or rash occurs: get medical advice. Store in a well-ventilated place. Keep container tightly closed. Dispose of contents and container
